subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: What fallback-order policy and configured-model capability contract should OpenClaw enforce before changing runtime selection or config validation?
rationale: The code still treats fallback lists and configured model inputs as operator intent, while stricter validation or policy-ranked ordering can change upgrade behavior and custom provider metadata semantics.

options.title: Set policy and guardrail contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the benchmark criteria and the capability authority, then implement code/docs/tests against that decision.

options.title: Split and narrow the work
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 as the guardrail tracker and create or retain a separate fallback-ranking tracker before closing this broader item.

options.title: Defer strict validation
options.body: Preserve current operator-declared metadata behavior for now and document the risk while only improving diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Set policy and guardrail contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the benchmark criteria and the capability authority, then implement code/docs/tests against that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: History and issue context point to steipete as the strongest routing candidate for fallback policy and provider/config contract decisions.
